summary: community.vmware removed many deprecated modules and inventory plugins with vmware.vmware replacements: vcenter_folder, vmware_cluster_ha, vmware_cluster_info, content library deploy/manager modules, vmware_guest_powerstate, vmware_host, vmware_maintenancemode, and the host/vm inventory plugins; vmware_dvs_portgroup mac_learning moved to network_policy.mac_learning.
questions: My vmware_vm_inventory inventory file stopped working, what should I use?
